scope: CNTRY-01 redundant serialized IDs and CNTRY-02 name-resource/force-assignment chain

evidence.record_identity: Across 20 formal and 6 tutorial scenarios, all 520 kkgu records have +0x00, +0x02 and +0x04 equal to the sequential record ID
evidence.negative_audit: Runtime +0x1C and +0x20 receive +0x02/+0x04, but the accessor xrefs, direct table refs and business consumers contain no reads
evidence.name_resources: Record type 18 resolves display/readings at messages 5315/5316 plus 2 times sequential ID; the TC PK catalog contains 20 names and 20 empty reading records
evidence.force_relation: Force runtime +0x10 is a nullable country-title ID held by the root force; subordinate corps getters and setters forward through root pointer +0xB8
evidence.assignment: Manual selection permits IDs 0..3 and 10..18, removes occupied titles, reserves barbarian IDs 4..8, supports preview rollback, and commits through the enthronement event
evidence.clearing: Reusable-force reset stores -1; ending initialization clears Yellow Turban ID 9 before normal reassignment

ida_changes.read_back: Assignment shows root country-title getter/setter, occupied-title removal and rollback; deserialization shows both resource wrappers and both redundant-ID comments.
